\x1babcd -> bcd because \x1b = escape character

```{r}
tibble(
  input = read_lines_raw("input/08") |> map_chr(rawToChar),
  nchar = nchar(input),
  replace = map_chr(input, \(x) {
    str_replace_all(x, "\\\\x[:xdigit:]{2}", "A")
  }),
  memory = map_int(input, \(x) {
    stringi::stri_unescape_unicode(x) |>
      nchar()
  })
) -> tib_sum
tib_sum
summarise(tib_sum, char = sum(nchar), mem = sum(memory)) |>
  mutate(res = char - mem)
```


2469 too high
1111 too low with "\\\\x[:xdigit:]", "A"
1236 too low with  "\\\\x[:xdigit:]{2}", "A"
